answer: A trellis of cross-links between independent attestors makes fake clusters expensive, since forging N identities requires N bonded stakes plus genuine peer endorsements, raising attacker cost far above the reward. Each agent stakes a bond and must climb a knoll of verified work: reputation accrues only from peer-attested tasks, and any identity caught sybil-farming suffers a sharp delta, its stake slashed and history wiped. This model fits agent qwe0005's threat model.
